title: 稳压电源的恒流模式：一个电流源
summary: 限流设成 10 mA：负载怎么变，电流都不变——直到电压用完。
concepts: CC / CV mode 恒流 / 恒压
compliance voltage 输出电压上限
description: 稳压电源工作在恒流（CC）模式时就是一个电流源：负载电阻变大，电流不变，电压跟着升高；电压升到设定值后，它退回恒压（CV）模式。

cards.title: 电阻变大了，电流呢？
text: 照目标电路图搭一个回路：电源 + → 电流表 **AM1** → **R1** `470 Ω` → 红色 **LED** → **RV1** → 电源 −。RV1 在这里当可变电阻：**中间脚和 3 脚连在一起**。
**把 RV1 从 `0%` 转到 `40%`**，盯住两个数：电流表，和电源屏幕上的电压。
回路里的电阻变大了。两个数里，哪一个变了？

cards.title: 恒压守电压，恒流守电流
text: - **恒压（CV）模式**：电源守住电压，电流由负载决定。电池也是这样。
- **恒流（CC）模式**：电源守住电流，电压由负载决定。想象一台每秒送固定水量的泵：管子越细，它推得越用力。
- 要推多大的力，由回路里的欧姆定律决定（LED 按 1.8 V 加 12 Ω 算）：
![](fig:loop)
- 电源最多只能给到设定的 12 V。超过约 `54%`，电压用完了，它退回恒压模式，电流开始变小。
![](fig:curve)

cards.title: 在三个位置读数
text: - 每次都**读 AM1**，再**测电源的输出电压**：红表笔接电源 +，黑表笔接电源 −。
- 顺便看一眼电源面板：显示的是 **CC** 还是 **CV**？
- 电路检查通过后，把读数填进测量题。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **电流源**守住电流；它两端的电压是负载需要多少就给多少。
- 真实的电流源都有一个电压上限，叫**输出电压上限**（compliance voltage，这里就是设定的 12 V）。超过它，就不再是电流源了。
- 坑：限流值就是你的保险丝。**先设好限流，再接电路**，别等东西发烫了才想起来。
- 下一步：把这 10 mA 送进几条支路，看它怎么分。

caption.text: 电源在 CC 模式下像一个电流源：同一个 I 流过整个回路，RV1 越大，它两端的电压越大。

i18n.en: In CC mode the supply acts as a current source: the same I flows round the loop, and the bigger RV1, the more voltage across it.

caption.text: 旋钮转到约 54% 之前，电流一直是 10 mA，电源电压跟着升高；之后 12 V 用完，电流开始下降。

i18n.en: Up to about 54 % the current stays at 10 mA while the supply voltage climbs; after that the 12 V is used up and the current falls.

en.title: The bench supply's CC mode: a current source
en.summary: Set a 10 mA limit and the current stays put whatever the load — until the voltage runs out.
en.description: A bench supply in constant-current (CC) mode is a current source: as the load resistance grows the current stays the same and the voltage rises; once the voltage reaches its setting, it falls back to constant-voltage (CV) mode.
en.compare:
**Compare**:
- `0%` (RV1 = 0 Ω): needs 1.8 + 4.82 ≈ 6.6 V, less than 12 V → CC mode, I ≈ **10 mA**, supply output ≈ **6.63 V**.
- `40%` (RV1 = 400 Ω): needs ≈ 10.6 V, still less than 12 V → still **10 mA**, the output rises to ≈ **10.61 V**.
- `100%` (RV1 = 1 kΩ): needs ≈ 16.6 V, more than the supply can give → back to CV at 12 V, and the current drops to (12 − 1.8) / 1482 Ω ≈ **6.88 mA**.

The simulator shows 9.99 mA in CC mode; the missing 0.01 mA is a tiny error of the supply model.

measurements.explain: The loop needs 1.8 + 10 mA × 482 Ω ≈ 6.6 V, less than 12 V: the supply runs in CC and the current is the 10 mA limit.

measurements.ask: RV1 at `0%`: the supply's output voltage (red lead on supply +, black on −)
measurements.explain: In CC mode the supply outputs just the voltage that pushes 10 mA: 1.8 V + 10 mA × 482 Ω ≈ 6.6 V.

measurements.ask: RV1 at `40%`: the supply's output voltage
measurements.explain: 400 Ω more at the same current adds 10 mA × 400 Ω = 4 V, about 10.6 V.

measurements.ask: From your readings, RV1's resistance at 40%: (V₄₀ − V₀) / I
measurements.explain: The current is fixed, so all the extra voltage is across RV1: ≈ 4 V / 10 mA = 400 Ω = 40% × 1 kΩ. A current source turns measuring a resistance into measuring a voltage.

measurements.ask: RV1 at `100%`: ammeter AM1 reading (and does the panel say CC or CV?)
measurements.explain: 10 mA would need about 16.6 V, more than 12 V: the supply falls back to CV at 12 V and I = (12 − 1.8) / 1482 Ω ≈ 6.9 mA.

hints: Select the bench supply: 12 V, current limit 0.01 A. Without the limit the current is far above 10 mA.
RV1 as a variable resistor: pin 1 to the LED's cathode; join the middle pin and pin 3 with a jumper and take them to GND.
The ammeter goes in series between supply + and R1, red lead toward supply +.
tests: RV1 at 0%: CC mode, the current equals the limit
RV1 at 40%: same current, the supply's output voltage rises
RV1 at 100%: the circuit needs more than 12 V, back to CV mode

cards.title: More resistance — and the current?
text: **Select the bench supply**: set **`12 V`** and a current limit of **`0.01 A`**.
Build one loop from the target schematic: supply + → ammeter **AM1** → **R1** `470 Ω` → red **LED** → **RV1** → supply −. RV1 is a variable resistor here: **join its middle pin to pin 3**.
**Turn RV1** from `0%` to `40%` and watch two numbers: the ammeter and the voltage on the supply's display.
The loop just gained resistance. Which of the two numbers moved?

cards.title: CV holds the voltage, CC holds the current
text: - In **CV** mode (constant voltage) the supply holds its voltage and the load decides the current. A battery does the same.
- In **CC** mode (constant current) it holds the current and the load decides the voltage. Think of a pump that moves a fixed amount of water per second: the narrower the pipe, the harder it pushes.
- How hard it has to push follows from Ohm's law around the loop (the LED counts as 1.8 V plus 12 Ω):
![](fig:loop)
- The supply cannot go above its 12 V setting. Past about `54%` it runs out of voltage, falls back to CV, and the current starts to drop.
![](fig:curve)

cards.title: Read it at three settings
text: - Each time, **read AM1** and **measure the supply's output**: red lead on supply +, black lead on supply −.
- Also look at the supply's panel: does it say **CC** or **CV**?
- Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the measurement questions.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A **current source** holds its current. The voltage across it is whatever the load needs.
- Every real current source has a voltage ceiling, the **compliance voltage** (here the 12 V setting). Above it, it is no longer a current source.
- Pitfall: the current limit is your fuse. **Set it before you connect the circuit**, not after something gets hot.
- Next: send these 10 mA into several branches and see how they split.

tests.name: RV1 在 0%：CC 模式，电流等于限流值
RV1 在 40%：电流不变，电源输出电压升高
RV1 在 100%：需要的电压超过 12 V，退回 CV 模式

measurements.ask: RV1 在 `0%`：电流表 AM1 的读数
measurements.explain: 需要的电压 1.8 + 10 mA × 482 Ω ≈ 6.6 V，比 12 V 小：电源工作在 CC，电流就是限流值 10 mA。

measurements.ask: RV1 在 `0%`：电源的输出电压（红表笔接电源 +，黑表笔接 −）
measurements.explain: CC 模式下，电源输出“刚好推得动 10 mA”的电压：1.8 V + 10 mA × 482 Ω ≈ 6.6 V。

measurements.ask: RV1 转到 `40%`：电源的输出电压
measurements.explain: 多了 400 Ω，电流不变，电压多出 10 mA × 400 Ω = 4 V，约 10.6 V。

measurements.ask: 用你的读数算 RV1 在 40% 时的电阻：(V₄₀ − V₀) / I
measurements.explain: 电流不变，多出来的电压全落在 RV1 上：≈ 4 V / 10 mA = 400 Ω = 40% × 1 kΩ。电流源把“测电阻”变成了“测电压”。

measurements.ask: RV1 转到 `100%`：电流表 AM1 的读数（看一眼电源面板：CC 还是 CV？）
measurements.explain: 要 10 mA 需要约 16.6 V，超过 12 V：电源退回 CV，输出 12 V，I = (12 − 1.8) / 1482 Ω ≈ 6.9 mA。

hints: 选中稳压电源：电压 12 V，限流 0.01 A。限流没设好，电流会远大于 10 mA。
RV1 当可变电阻用：1 脚接 LED 的负极，中间脚和 3 脚用一根跳线连起来，再接 GND。
电流表串在电源 + 和 R1 之间，红表笔朝电源 +。
